description: Checkmyguest offers you this 107 m² apartment in the heart of Paris' 3rd arrondissement. With its three bedrooms and numerous amenities, this space promises all the comfort and warmth of a real home.The space⭐ Nestled in the heart of the picturesque Beaubourg district, this 107 m² apartment offers immersion in an atmosphere as welcoming as it is warm. Ideally located on the first floor, it can accommodate up to ten people. Take advantage of this elegant and functional accommodation for a pleasant stay in the City of Light, where every detail has been thought of for your comfort. This location allows you to explore Paris using easily accessible public transport. You'll be able to reach the city's various emblematic sites: Parc Monceau, the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, the Sacré Coeur, the Champs-Elysées, the Arc de Triomphe... In absolute comfort, you'll enjoy :✔️Un A spacious living room with a soft sofa-bed and other comfortable furnishings to ensure optimal well-being during your moments of relaxation.✔️ A fully equipped kitchen (fridge, hob, coffee machine, microwave, kettle, oven) to showcase your skills. oven) to showcase your most exquisite culinary skills.✔️Un A dining area in the living room and another in the kitchen, ideal for enjoying convivial moments with friends and family.✔️Un Tastefully landscaped patio, perfect for enjoying the cool, sunny weather.✔️Deux bedrooms, each with a double bed, offer a haven of peace for restful nights in a serene, soothing environment.✔️Une A third bedroom, with two double beds, guarantees optimum comfort for your nights' sleep.✔️ A full bathroom, adjoining the third bedroom, with shower, bath and toilet to meet all your hygiene and cleanliness needs.✔️ Two bathrooms adjoining the first two bedrooms, each with a washbasin
